components.name: momentum

components.name: trend
components.justification: Captures sustained uptrend direction and strength

components.name: volume
components.justification: High volume confirms momentum, low volume shows caution

components.name: volatility
components.justification: Penalizes both too-low and too-high volatility

weights.calibration_note: Weights chosen to balance momentum (0.70) with regime (0.30)

confidence_calculation.lookback_bars_used: 14-21 bars for MA, ATR, volume averages

gates.justification: Signal produces ~0.50 confidence; threshold 0.55 creates natural filtering
gates.calibration_study: Phase 2 engineering test: 419 trades with forced 0.60 confidence proved framework
gates.change_process: 1. Propose new threshold with evidence. 2. Backtest new value on locked historical data. 3. Document calibration study. 4. Approve + bump version. 5. Lock new version.

components.slippage: Not in statutory costs; modeled separately as 0.5 paise/unit

costs.change_process: New costs only if Zerodha rate change confirmed + versioned

risk_gates.change_process: Calibration study required, version bump on change

test_methodology.step_1: Engineering test: forced 0.60 confidence, prove transaction lifecycle
test_methodology.step_2: Gate tests: verify all 18 gates pass and fail as designed
test_methodology.step_3: Real signal 5-symbol: genuine ~0.50 confidence, accept 0 trades
test_methodology.step_4: Full 48-symbol real signal: complete universe with locked config
test_methodology.step_5: Phase 3 optimization: only after steps 1-4 pass with config locked

approval_required_for.threshold_changes: Backtest both periods, documented calibration study
approval_required_for.cost_assumption_changes: Evidence of rate change from broker
approval_required_for.data_changes: Frozen data only; new data = new version

no_auto_tuning.rationale: Prevents system from gaming itself by chasing trades
